Unverified, estimated and fictional values (optimizer catalog, costs, instruments, spacecraft components, Falcon/Starship/Electron and most engine specs, user-supplied SpaceX table) were removed. Derived values are computed only from verified inputs and are labelled derived.

retrieval.reason: Only retrieved sources are used; see metadata sources and field_verification on each record.

quality.statement: STRICT MODE: this dataset contains only values that were compared with, or ingested directly from, retrieved authoritative sources (JPL SSD/SBDB/NHATS, NASA NSSDC, NASA SLS page, Apollo 11 press kit, NTRS papers, ULA, ESA, data.nasa.gov). Unverified, estimated and fictional values (optimizer catalog, costs, instruments, spacecraft components, Falcon/Starship/Electron and most engine specs, user-supplied SpaceX table) were removed. Derived values are computed only from verified inputs and are labelled derived.

known_conflicts.note: Records or fields that could not be verified are excluded, not zero-filled; coverage is therefore partial by design. See staging reports for what was removed and why.

The user-supplied NASA_Facilities.csv agrees with the official data.nasa.gov table on 485 of 485 facilities (center and coordinates); the official table is used. Official contact names and phone numbers are not ingested.
